video.description:
The ultimate summer appetizer or side! Vegan (& optionally gluten-free) corn fritters that are SO flavorful, a little spicy & perfectly crispy on the outside (without deep frying). Simple methods & just 1 bowl + 30 minutes required!

Full Recipe: https://minimalistbaker.com/easy-vegan-corn-fritters/

recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup MB 1:1 Gluten-Free Flour Blend ((or store-bought* // if not gluten-free, you can use all-purpose flour))
1 ½ cups corn kernels ((cut off the cob, or thawed from frozen and lightly dried // 2 small ears corn yield ~1 ½ cups or 235 g))
1-2 Tbsp finely chopped jalapeño ((depending on preferred spiciness))
Avocado oil ((for cooking // or sub other neutral oil))

recipeInstructions.text: Prepare a baking sheet by placing a layer of paper towels on it and flipping a cooling rack upside down on top of them. This will catch any extra oil from frying and keep your fritters crispy.
recipeInstructions.name: Prepare a baking sheet by placing a layer of paper towels on it and flipping a cooling rack upside down on top of them. This will catch any extra oil from frying and keep your fritters crispy.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large mixing bowl, stir together the flaxseed meal and dairy-free milk. Let this sit for 5 minutes.
recipeInstructions.name: In a large mixing bowl, stir together the flaxseed meal and dairy-free milk. Let this sit for 5 minutes.

recipeInstructions.text: After 5 minutes, add the nutritional yeast, baking powder, sea salt, and garlic powder to the flax mixture. Whisk everything to combine, then add the flour and whisk once more — it should be a thick batter. Finally, fold in the corn and chopped jalapeño. If the mixture is too runny, add extra flour. If it’s too thick, add a little more dairy-free milk.

If it’s too thick, add a little more dairy-free milk.

recipeInstructions.text: Coat a large skillet (we used a 10-inch cast iron) with a thin layer of oil (~1 Tbsp) over medium-high heat. When the oil is hot (test it by dropping in a small dollop of batter — it should sizzle), begin cooking your fritters. Drop in 3 Tbsp portions of batter (we used this cookie scoop heaped with batter) and press with the back of your cookie scoop or spoon. Work in batches, adding only as many fritters as will fit comfortably in the pan. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown. Remove from the skillet, placing the fritters on your prepared baking sheet. Repeat with remaining batter, adding more oil to your skillet as needed.

recipeInstructions.text: Enjoy with guacamole, cashew jalapeño sauce, or vegan ranch. Best served immediately but can be kept in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. To reheat, place the fritters in a lightly oiled skillet or 350-degree Fahrenheit (176 C) oven until warmed through.

review.reviewBody: Hi! Another recipe of yours that I will keep on making! I used a mix of all-purpose and whole wheat flour, no nooch (don't like it so much), and also no jalapeños, but added black pepper to the mix! I really liked it and think I'll be including it other veggies next time as well! <3

Fabulous!  My hubbie says this is right out of his childhood because his grandma used to make him corn fritters.  Super easy to make and doesn't take many ingredients so basically, you could make this if you were low on funds (which a lot of people are these days).  We did as you said and put smidge of vegan ranch on top...delicious and they hold together perfectly.  We used avocado oil when frying in our cast iron.  Worked out perfectly

I made this last night and it was delicious!!! These are the first vegetable fritters I've made that actually held their shape during cooking. I used a little more oil than recommended to cook them (because I'm a oil hedonist) and they came out so delightfully crispy while soft inside. The combination of ingredients was tasty and next time I will try adding chopped cilantro. I could have eaten more and more of these wonderful fritters. Thanks so much for this recipe!
Delicious! Have made many attempts at "fritters", with various veg ingredients, over the years and this recipe is the best I've ever tried. Many thanks.
